us.heading: Who are we ?
us.subheading1: For centuries, African marabouts have guided communities with wisdom and clairvoyance. As advisors, mediators and guardians of knowledge, they embodied an enlightened authority capable of transforming challenges into opportunities. Today, Marabu reinvents this heritage.
us.subheading2: Founded in 2023, Marabu emerges as a strategic actor in consulting, services and inter-mediation, combining tradition and technology to accompany its partners in a world of perpetual evolution.
us.lidescription: Unir les traditions aux technologies modernes.
us.lidescription2: Contribute to sustainable and inclusive development.
us.lidescription3: Offer customized solutions to your needs.
us.textdownn: We are the contemporary translators of African wisdom in modern strategic action.

mission.heading: Tasks to perform
mission.subheading: The mission of Marabu is to embody excellence and innovation through concrete and strategic solutions. We position ourselves as a catalyst for transformation for businesses and institutions, accompanying them in their growth, digitalization and sustainable performance. Our approach is based on a fine understanding of current and future issues, as well as the ability to anticipate economic, social and technological changes.
mission.subheading2: Through our inter-mediation, consulting and operational accompaniment services, we build bridges between local needs and global opportunities. Marabu commits to providing tailored responses, with high added value, while placing human, innovation and long-term vision at the heart of each mission. Together, we shape success trajectories, with agility, audacity and impact.

teamMembers.name: Houssène Ben Souda
teamMembers.bio: With more than 20 years of experience in strategic consulting and business transformation, Houssène Ben Souda accompanies businesses and institutions in the development of high-impact projects in Africa and Europe. He is a graduate of international business schools, combining technical expertise and strategic vision to create innovative and tailored solutions.
achievements: Strategic accompaniment of Yango in Francophone Africa (institutional negotiations, territorial expansion)
Pilotage of the e-commerce white book in Côte d'Ivoire

Coordination of national workshops on digital inclusion and social protection (e.g. integration of VTC drivers)
Structuring RSE mediation projects for the private sector

teamMembers.name: Thomas Dabadie
teamMembers.bio: With 15 years of experience in large consulting firms, Thomas Dabadie accompanies the masterminds in the execution of strategic plans, organization restructuring and process optimization. Specialized in banking, insurance, industry and public sector, he intervenes from the initial audit to the implementation of change and continuous improvement through process automation (RPA).

expertise: Performance optimization of purchases and supply chain

visions.heading: Key objective
visions.subheading: At Marabu, our vision is based on the conviction that the success of businesses and institutions is based on innovation, agility and collective intelligence. We aspire to become a reference actor in strategic and digital accompaniment, creating bridges between local ambitions and global opportunities.
visions.subheading2: Our key objective: to allow our partners to take a long-term lead in a constantly evolving world. We put our expertise at the service of concrete, inclusive and durable solutions, integrating human, technological and performance at the heart of each project. Because thinking globally, acting locally and succeeding globally, this is more than a slogan — it's our commitment.
